concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-019 (sensitivity analysis for K = {50, 100, 150}) is not referenced in any phase of the plan. The table lists phases 0‑7 but none mention FR-019, leaving this requirement unbacked.

Success Criterion SC-006 (resource usage ≤ 7 GB RAM and ≤ 6 h runtime) is not explicitly covered by any phase. Although FR-016 (resource guardrails) appears in Phase 7, the corresponding success criterion SC-006 is missing, so the plan lacks a measurable check for the resource limits.
